ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white geometric blobs occupy the central and distal areas of both lobes. High-contrast black pigmentation is mapped along the leading edges, the central notch junction, and the extreme terminal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped vertex angle of approximately 65 degrees; the base of the notch is partially occluded by water surface turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern with multiple peaks and valleys (amplitude approx 3-5 pixels) distributed along the continuous linear boundary of both trailing edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature fitted to the outer posterior edges of the lobes, tapering to acute points at the fluke tips.
